injuries.longComment: Sweat has had varied levels of practice this week as the star defensive end has been awarded veteran rest to deal with his groin issue. The linebacker having vet rest days through a DNP on Wednesday, a full session Thursday and a limited session Friday points toward Sweat suiting up for Sunday's contest, though he may not play his usual snap count on the edge.
injuries.shortComment: Sweat (groin) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injuries.longComment: Carter will be forced to miss at least the first four games of the regular season due to a knee injury he sustained in training camp practice in early August. With rookie fourth-rounder Kaleb Proctor (knee) out for the entire season, Andrew Billings, L.J. Collier and Keveion'ta Spears will serve as the Cardinals' rotational defensive tackles behind Roy Lopez and Walter Nolen for as long as Carter is sidelined.
injuries.shortComment: The Cardinals placed Carter (knee) on injured reserve Sunday with a designation to return, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injuries.longComment: Johnson suffered a neck injury in the 31-7 loss to the Seahawks in Week 2. He was placed on injured reserve, so he is guaranteed to miss at least four games. However, the 23-year-old isn't expected to play again this season. If that's the case, he will finish the year with eight total tackles (three solo), one fumble recovery and one pass defended. Without Johnson, Garrett Williams (Achilles), who has yet to play this season, could take on a larger role upon his return. Max Melton (toe), Kei'Trel Clark and Starling Thomas, the latter who was promoted from the practice squad, may also be more involved.
injuries.shortComment: The Cardinals placed Johnson (neck) on injured reserve  Wednesday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injuries.longComment: Taylor-Demerson did not participate in any Week 4 prep while he continues to recover from a back injury. The safety will now miss consecutive weeks due to the issue, leaving Wydett Williams as the only active reserve safety for the Cardinals' game against the Giants on Sunday.
injuries.shortComment: Taylor-Demerson (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injuries.longComment: Crawford sustained a mid ankle sprain and was carted off the field during the second half of Sunday's win against the Chargers, and now he'll have to sit out at least Arizona's next four games. Until he's able to return to action, 2024 fourth-rounder Dadrion Taylor-Demerson (ribs) and undrafted rookie Wydett Williams could be in line for a slight increase in reps.
injuries.shortComment: The Cardinals placed Crawford (ankle) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
